items.summary_original: Skydio’s drones have always been magical. From MIT research and early prototypes to what I would argue is still the most advanced consumer drone ever made , this is a company that makes very cool stuff. Sadly, Skydio no longer makes cool stuff for consumers , instead focusing on drone platforms for public safety, inspection, and other things that, on a good day, don’t affect me personally.

items.summary_original: Scientists have uncovered a hidden warning sign in routine heart scans that could predict sudden cardiac death before it strikes. The AI-powered discovery outperformed conventional screening methods, potentially revealing thousands of people at risk of a fatal heart malfunction that doctors might otherwise miss.

The breakthrough allows scientists to predict how laser pulses behave inside special crystals in just milliseconds, without sacrificing much accuracy. This could dramatically improve the precision and efficiency of powerful X-ray lasers used in cutting-edge scientific research.

items.summary: 如果“人都会犯错”，那么你可以说机器人是超人。他们比我们更容易出错，即使是在做一些我们可能认为很容易的家务和工厂家务时也是如此。造成这些错误的原因之一是，机器人很难从过去提取相关细节并实时采取行动，即使使用视觉语言模型（VLM）来解释视频和图像等视觉输入以及自然语言也是如此。
items.summary_original: If "to err is human," you could say robots are superhuman. They're more error-prone than we are, even when tasked with things like home and factory chores, which we might consider easy. One reason for these mistakes is that robots struggle to extract relevant details from the past and act on them in real time, even with vision-language models (VLMs), which interpret visual inputs such as videos and images along with natural language.

items.summary_original: Robotics companies are investing heavily in the belief that data will solve the most difficult problems in robotics. Once AI systems have ingested enough data from human demonstrations, the thinking goes, robots will be able to perform the vast majority of the manual tasks that humans now do. There are even robotics companies that exist solely to collect training data and sell it to other robotics companies in pursuit of this goal.

judgement.summary: 整体偏多：人形机器人产线验证与演示节点密集前移，上游零部件订单预期改善，但多数事件仍处测试与计划阶段，短期估值催化强于业绩兑现。

items.logic: 智元精灵G2批量进入蓝思手机测试产线、特斯拉给出两个月内Optimus演示时间表，整机厂从展示转向真实工位验证，若测试通过将打开消费电子与重工业场景订单，抬升本体环节估值中枢。
灵掌机器人多款灵巧手在智博会展示工业、太空与特种作业落地场景，末端执行环节的可用性提升，带动灵巧手及微型传动部件的验证需求与配套订单预期。
整机产线测试与演示计划增多，理论上拉动谐波与RV减速器打样需求，但当前仍处小批量验证阶段，尚未形成规模订单，对短期业绩传导有限。
启元机器人与邮电器材消费电子事业部共建线下体验与零售交付体系，机器人销售渠道开始铺设，但收入贡献取决于后续门店落地节奏，暂难量化。
